voiceoverSegments.line: We start by loading the last 1,000 candles, giving the strategy its full price history to work from.
Next we calculate a 14‑period RSI, the classic oscillator that swings between 0 and 100 to spot extremes.
We add a red horizontal line that will act as our overbought reference on the chart.
A crossunder triggers when the RSI falls below 70, signalling a bearish shift in momentum.
We plot the RSI series in blue so its movements are clearly visible on the chart.
A crossover fires when the RSI climbs above 30, marking a bullish reversal signal.
We add a green horizontal line at the 30 level to highlight the oversold boundary.
We place green shape markers on the chart each time a bullish crossover occurs.
Red shape markers appear whenever the RSI crossunder signals a bearish entry.
We then run the strategy through the backtest engine, generating a complete trade ledger and performance metrics.
Finally we plot the trades themselves, overlaying entry and exit markers so the strategy’s actions are visible.

outro.voiceover: Now the chart shows the RSI with its overbought and oversold lines, bullish and bearish signals, and the plotted trades, ready to backtest.
